name: Governed learning loop v1-to-v2 shadow pilot

tasks.rubric: Score 1 only when proposals enforce one to four distinct edits.
Score 1 only when evaluation requires at least two distinct replay run IDs and gates every run.
Score 1 only when a critical-task regression rejects the proposal and is retained.
Score 1 only when both per-run candidate cost and cost-increase ratio are enforced.
Score 1 only when replay acceptance still cannot deploy without explicit proposal approval.
